acceptance: The refusal names `evolve comments history …` and running exactly that command from the repo root records the history so the gate passes (the existing end-to-end test, retargeted)
No doc tells the author to use `go run ./cmd/commentaudit history`
fix: Change recordHistoryCommand to the `evolve comments history` spelling (check how a relative -out resolves under `evolve comments`), update the refusal test that pins the command, and the docs that quote it (code-comments convention, skills/commit/SKILL.md, runtime-reference).
summary: ADR-0115's history refusal tells the author to run `cd go && go run ./cmd/commentaudit history ...` (commitgate.recordHistoryCommand, and the docs that point to it). Cycle 1792 (2026-10-05) published the same tool as `evolve comments`, which runs the same commentaudit.Main with the same arguments from anywhere in the repo. Every control should go through the published evolve CLI, so the refusal should name `evolve comments history -base <ref> -label <change> -out docs/history/code-comments`.
title: The commit gate's history refusal names `evolve comments history`, the published command
